description:
At 1001Legends.com, we work with driven change makers who want to 'BE THE CHANGE they want to see in the world'. 

 We offer mentorship and professional training to young adults (15-25) AND their mentors through an exchange programme between India and Europe.

We encourage the '1001 Heroes of the Future' to step into their most beautiful vision for their own lives, their community and why not, the world- and help them find a way to make that dream come true.

Our WRITE YOUR OWN LEGEND challenge is the first step in a 9-step QUEST to help young people become the hero of their very own legend. 

Upon completion of this 'script writing' course, these aspiring heroes will have a SCRIPT for their most beautiful vision for the next 2-5 years AND a proven method to actually bring that vision to life
- for themselves and the people and causes they love.

The most heroic stories will be in with a chance of winning one of the coveted gold coins and possibly, after receiving 3 of them, becoming one of 10 BE THE CHANGE mentors in our school.

You will get a 30% commission on total referral turn-over when someone decides to sign up for the program "Write your own legend, using your affiliate link.
term_and_condition:
Thank you for joining our Mentoring Programme.

Please read these terms and conditions before signing up.

At 1001legends.com, we support Change Bringers in achieving their goals and bringing forth their most beautiful vision of 'Paradise on Earth'.  

In the New Earth Paradigm, this also means resetting how people deal with fortune, money and wealth. 

And how we are to do this is by always looking for a win-win first!

WIN 1 : "What's in it for me" and

WIN 2: "What's in it for them?"

As a BE THE CHANGE Mentor, these two questions will be your mantra for the next 2-3 years. 

But beyond that, this affiliate programme has been set up with the 4 Wins in mind, because it focuses not only on WIN 1 & WIN 2, but also on

WIN 3: "What's in it for Mother Earth"? and

WIN 4: "What's in it for your Higher Self/Soul's Purpose"?

Only when all 4 WIN's are in alignment, will Life on Earth become abundant for all. 

When you sign up for this program, it's crucial that you understand this concept and are willing to contribute to its success. 

Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Els Cuypers

Founder and director of the BE THE CHANGE Academy.
